questions.question_text:
The table shows the progress of a savings annuity with annual contributions of $\$5000$ at $4\%$ p.a. compounded annually.

$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Year} & \text{Opening} & \text{Interest } (4\%) & \text{Deposit} & \text{Closing} \\ \hline 1 & \$0 & \$0 & \$5000 & \$5000 \\ 2 & \$5000 & \text{---} & \$5000 & \text{---} \\ \hline \end{array}$

What is the closing balance at the end of Year $2$?

options.why: Omitted the interest earned on the opening balance in Year 2.
Calculated interest on the deposit rather than the opening balance.
Failed to add the previous year opening balance to the closing balance.

questions.question_text:
A loan of $\$12\,000$ incurs interest at $0.5\%$ per month with monthly repayments of $\$750$.

$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Month} & \text{Opening} & \text{Interest } (0.5\%) & \text{Repayment} & \text{Closing} \\ \hline 1 & \$12\,000 & \$60.00 & \$750 & \$11\,310.00 \\ 2 & \$11\,310.00 & \text{---} & \$750 & \text{---} \\ \hline \end{array}$

Find the closing balance at the end of Month $2$, to the nearest cent.

options.why: Omitted the monthly interest addition before subtracting the repayment.
Used Month 1 interest instead of calculating interest on Month 2 opening balance.
Added the monthly repayment to the balance instead of subtracting it.

questions.question_text: A savings annuity is modelled by the recurrence relation $V_{n} = V_{n-1} \times 1.03 + 500$, where $V_{0} = 0$. Determine the balance $V_{3}$ after $3$ payments.

options.why: Ignored compounding interest across the intermediate periods.
Applied interest only to the first period deposit instead of compounding.
Added interest to the final deposit before adding to the balance.

questions.question_text: A loan is modelled by the recurrence relation $V_{n} = V_{n-1} \times 1.01 - 400$, with $V_{0} = 5000$. Find the balance owing $V_{2}$ after $2$ repayments.

options.why: Subtracted two repayments without adding monthly interest charges.
Reused initial interest amount for both periods rather than updating balance.
Added the repayments to the debt rather than reducing the balance.

questions.question_text: An annuity investment table shows that after $3$ annual deposits of $\$2500$, the closing balance is $\$7804$. How much total interest was earned over the $3$ years?

options.why: Subtracted only one deposit of \$2500 from the final closing balance.
Calculated the total deposits instead of the interest earned.
Subtracted two deposits instead of three deposits from the balance.

questions.question_text: A savings account table shows Month 1 ending balance $\$600$. Month 2 shows opening balance $\$600$, interest earned $\$18$, deposit $\$600$, and closing balance $\$1218$. What is the monthly interest rate $r$?

options.why: Confused the dollar interest amount of \$18 with a percentage value.
Divided the decimal rate by 100 instead of multiplying by 100 to get percent.
Multiplied the monthly rate by 12 to give annual rate instead of monthly.

questions.question_text: A loan of $\$6000$ has quarterly interest of $2\%$ and repayments of $\$1000$ per quarter. What is the interest in Quarter 1 and the closing balance after Quarter 1?

options.why: Subtracted repayment from principal without adding the interest.
Calculated interest at half the specified quarterly interest rate.
Added the repayment to the debt instead of reducing the loan balance.

questions.question_text: A loan is modelled by the recurrence relation $V_{n} = V_{n-1}(1.02) - 150$, with $V_{0} = 10\,000$. Which statement explains why the balance $V_{n}$ increases over time?

options.text: The periodic interest charged ($\$200$) is greater than the repayment ($\$150$).
The repayment of $\$150$ is greater than the initial principal of $\$10\,000$.
options.why: Claimed the repayment exceeds the loan principal, which is factually false.

options.text: The interest rate of $2\%$ is applied to the repayment instead of the balance.
options.why: Asserted interest is incorrectly calculated on repayments rather than balance.

options.text: The recurrence relation adds payments instead of subtracting them from debt.
options.why: Misread the minus sign in the formula as addition of debt repayments.

questions.solution_text:
$\text{Initial Interest} = 10\,000 \times 0.02 = \$200$
Since the repayment $\$150$ is less than the $\$200$ interest, the balance increases.

questions.question_text: A $3$-month loan table starting at $\$3000$ has monthly payments of $\$350$. If the closing balance after Month $3$ is $\$2005.10$, calculate the total interest charged over the $3$ months.

options.why: Calculated the reduction in principal instead of total interest charged.
Calculated total repayments made without subtracting the principal reduction.
Subtracted principal reduction from two repayments instead of three.
